P3_which_scoreboard.arithmetic: the boost only DISAPPEARS when the gated body is AIRBORNE. Terrain field-starts in the 17,381-game store are Electric 237 / Psychic 110 / Grassy 13 / Misty 4 -- 1.87% of games carry any terrain. Over 961 pool games that is ~18 games with a terrain at all, ~13 Electric and ~6 Psychic. Inside those, --steering empirical must then sample Rising Voltage (24 carriers) or Expanding Force (38 carriers) AND the gated body must be airborne (a Flying type or a Levitate/E-Elevate body, well under a third of the field). The product is well under one game. Misty Explosion is zero: 4 Misty field-starts in the whole store and 0 Misty Explosion clicks under one.
P3_which_scoreboard.explicit_caveat: --steering empirical samples P(move | species); it does NOT replay the store's clicks, so the scope's 103 Rising Voltage clicks and 147 Expanding Force clicks do NOT translate into pool games. The last batch made exactly this mistake in the other direction (predicted a still pool at a 0.8-game expectation and the pool delivered 2), so the band below is stated wide on purpose and a MOVE of one or two games is INSIDE the prediction, not against it.
